''See also: [[Xorrus Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Xorrus is a powerful gold dragon and a [[Herald]] who serves as the left hand to the [[Dragon Monarch]]. Known by titles such as the Eternal Sandstorm, Desert-bringer, and the Breath of Destruction, she possesses significant influence and territory. In her draconic form, she is capable of devastating attacks, including dragon breath, and has been known to use lesser [[dragons]] as decoys for her strikes. She is also capable of assuming a perfect human appearance characterized by golden hair and human eyes. Beyond her role as a high-ranking official for the [[Dragon King]], Xorrus is a family-oriented individual who has shown deep concern for her granddaughter, [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]. She has intervened in [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]]'s magical advancements to prevent potential harm to her [[Path]]. Despite her capacity for vengeance and destruction, she has also demonstrated a sense of mercy by releasing humans from traps. Her history includes long-standing conflicts and the accumulation of immense power over time.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Xorrus is a gold dragon.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As the left hand of the [[Dragon Monarch]], Xorrus is a [[Herald]] who once held territory in Eastern [[Ashwind]]. This individual sought revenge against a village after experiencing an increase in power.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Xorrus serves as the left hand to the [[Dragon Monarch]]. She is the grandmother of [[Sopharanatoth{{!}}Sophara]] and was eventually killed by [[Fury]]. Additionally, [[Lindon]] had intentions of beating on her.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Known by the titles Desert-bringer, the Breath of Destruction, and the Eternal Sandstorm, Xorrus is a [[Herald]].}}
